item_name: Rothco Vintage U.S. Navy Eagle Low Profile Cap
item_short_desc: Rothco's Vintage U.S. Navy Eagle Low Profile Cap is a perfect blend of style and comfort for anyone wanting to showcase their allegiance to the U.S. Navy. This cap features a striking 3D embroidered Navy Eagle insignia on the front, symbolizing honor and commitment. The left side of the brim proudly displays "U.S. Navy," while the adjustable hook and loop closure at the back ensures a snug fit for all head sizes.
